title: Search: keep old sort names working
description: Partner widgets and bookmarked links still use the sort names of the old search (cheapest, price, best_deal, date) and get a 422 today. SearchOffersRequest now maps them onto the current sorts before validation. Tests for every alias.

defects.explanation: Any unknown sort value is silently rewritten to 'factor', so typos and garbage pass validation with a 200 instead of a 422 (the PR also drops the test that rejected an unknown sort); only the listed aliases should be mapped.
